body: Pinaka-important evidence nuance: fresh fire report is a reason to re-surface the recall, pero hindi pa evidence na the known defect caused these newest fires. That distinction protects the alert from becoming fear marketing. Mas striking sa akin ang recovery-rate data itself: 44.0% for the speaker and only 9.8% for the old aircon population. So the real discovery question is why recall penetration stays low years later—and whether Japan needs better owner tracing or retailer/device-registration channels, not just another warning notice.

claims.text: Low recall recovery rates make recall-delivery and owner-tracing mechanisms worth investigating separately from the defect itself.
claims.basis: Inference from the article's verified recovery rates and active recall remedies
